headline: Malware Incident Halts Production at Minebea AccessSolutions in Thailand
body: A severe malware outbreak has disrupted operations at Minebea AccessSolutions factories in Thailand, formerly known as Honda Lock Thai. The infection forced an immediate halt to production activities across several facilities. Efforts are underway to restore affected systems, with expectations for a phased resumption in operations. At this time, no official ransom demands have been disclosed by the company.
